story: As a reviewer I want each source line classified as blank, comment or code so that the tool can count the three kinds separately
As a reviewer I want a line's indentation measured in spaces so that nesting depth can be derived from it
As a reviewer I want function definition lines recognised so that the tool knows where each function starts
As a reviewer I want an indentation width converted to a nesting depth so that deeply nested code can be flagged
As a reviewer I want the parameters in a definition counted so that functions with too many parameters can be flagged
As a reviewer I want comment density as a percentage so that poorly documented files can be flagged
As a reviewer I want comment density banded so that the report can describe it in words
As a reviewer I want each line's length graded against a limit so that over-long lines can be reported by seriousness
As a reviewer I want a source file reduced to a record per function so that every later stage works on numbers instead of text
As a reviewer I want the decision keywords in a function totalled so that cyclomatic complexity can be computed from them
As a reviewer I want each function's cyclomatic complexity computed so that over-complex functions can be flagged
As a reviewer I want the deepest nesting level in a function found so that deeply nested code can be flagged
As a reviewer I want penalty points charged for excess nesting so that the score reflects how far past the limit the code is
As a reviewer I want a parameter count rated so that the report can describe it in words
As a reviewer I want duplication expressed as a percentage so that copied code can be flagged
As a reviewer I want a function's length rated so that over-long functions can be described in words
As a reviewer I want complexity, nesting and parameters combined into one rating so that the report has a single per-function verdict
As a reviewer I want a maintainability index per function so that complexity and documentation are weighed together
As a reviewer I want a measurement banded against its limit so that every rule grades its findings on one consistent scale
As a reviewer I want functions over the complexity limit reported so that I know which functions to simplify
As a reviewer I want functions nested too deeply reported so that I know which functions to flatten
As a reviewer I want over-long functions reported so that I know which functions to split
As a reviewer I want functions with too many parameters reported so that I know which signatures to simplify
As a reviewer I want insufficiently commented files reported so that I know which files need documenting
As a reviewer I want over-long lines reported so that I know which lines to wrap
As a reviewer I want duplicated blocks reported so that I know which code to factor out
As a reviewer I want a list of severities reduced to the worst one so that a function can be summarised by its most serious finding
As a reviewer I want each severity to carry a penalty weight so that serious findings cost more than trivial ones
As a reviewer I want a quality score from the issues found so that a file's state is a single number
As a reviewer I want a letter grade from the score so that the result is readable at a glance
As a reviewer I want a report turned into text lines so that it can be stored without a database
As a reviewer I want stored lines parsed back and corrupt ones rejected so that one bad line does not destroy my history
As a reviewer I want two reviews compared so that I can see whether a file improved or regressed
As a reviewer I want reviews appended to a file and read back so that my review history survives restarting the tool
As a reviewer I want the trend across my review history described so that I can see the direction of travel
As a reviewer I want the minimum, maximum and mean of my scores so that I can summarise a file's history
